items.t: Sponsored Senate Bill 80, which places a candidate's party affiliation next to their name on the ballot for Ohio Supreme Court and district courts of appeals races.
items.q: I sponsored Senate Bill 80 with Senator Cirino last General Assembly because Ohio Supreme Court and district courts of appeals races lacked basic transparency. The bill ensures a candidate’s party affiliation is next to their name on the ballot

record.t: Served in the Ohio Senate since 2019 after serving in the Ohio House since 2016.
record.q: Senator Theresa Gavarone has served in the Ohio Senate since 2019 and is currently in her second full term after having previously served in the Ohio House since 2016.

record.t: Was appointed chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee for the remainder of the 136th General Assembly by Senate President Rob McColley.
record.q: Senator Theresa Gavarone (R-Bowling Green) has been appointed to serve as chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee for the remainder of the 136th General Assembly, by Senate President Rob McColley (R-Napoleon).

record.t: Was elected by Senate colleagues to serve as Senate Majority Floor Leader for the 136th General Assembly.
record.q: She was elected by her Senate colleagues to serve as Senate Majority Floor Leader for the 136th General Assembly.

record.t: Served as a member of the Bowling Green City Council before serving in the Ohio Legislature.
record.q: As a resident of Northern Ohio for over 35 years, Senator Gavarone was a member of the Bowling Green City Council before serving in the Ohio Legislature.

record.t: Sponsored numerous bills on topics including elections security, religious freedom of expression, school bus safety, mental health care access, communications disabilities, cyber security and water quality.
record.q: Senator Gavarone has sponsored numerous bills on many different topics including elections security, religious freedom of expression, school bus safety, mental health care access, communications disabilities, cyber security, water quality, and others.
